name: robots/frankarobotics__franka_ros
title: Franka Hand ROS 1 gripper
intro: Franka Hand ROS 1 gripper, adapted from frankarobotics/franka_ros. It reads `finger_positions`; runs `grasp`, `move_gripper`, `home_gripper` and `stop_gripper`. `grasp`: close the gripper on a target object with a bounded force and report the achieved grasp width. A failed grasp is a completed operation with grasped=false, not a silent success. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
